messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Razvan, nothing has shipped yet. Your Thor P2 is reserved at our Rotterdam warehouse and the order ships October 29, with the EU Power Kit and the Harlo OS diagnostics in the same box.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The paperwork flag I mentioned is already in front of the team. They're offline over the weekend and pick it up Monday at 10am ET, and you'll get the confirmation by email, so you don't need to wait here.

Tracking goes to (email hidden) the moment it leaves.
